title: Gunchained
pitch: A curated library of nearly 300 Gods Unchained videos from 16 creators, sorted into categories like Decks and Strategy so players find the good stuff fast.
description: A Vue and Vuetify single page app on Firestore. Signed-in players can share challenge codes in the Arena, admins add videos straight from a YouTube link, and a Vercel function serves the newest videos as RSS.

externals.name: Firebase (Firestore, Auth and the RSS function)
externals.note: The site and a local run both read the real video library from Firestore; signing in uses real Firebase accounts.

externals.name: YouTube Data API
externals.seam: the API key field on the upload page
externals.note: Only admins adding videos need it, with their own key.
